build_CosineAnnealingLR: build a cosine annealing learning rate scheduler for an optimizer with configurable T_max and eta_min
create_OneCycleLR: create a one cycle learning rate scheduler that anneals LR from initial to max then to minimum
review_CosineRestartLR: review the CosineRestartLR class that implements cosine annealing with restarts and configurable restart weights
build_ReduceOnPlateauLR: build a reduce on plateau LR scheduler that reduces LR when a monitored metric stops improving
create_ExponentialLR: create an exponential learning rate scheduler that decays LR by gamma factor every epoch
